title: Picking the elder's coffer lock happens 'while the elder's back is turned' with no 'elder sees you' flag (unlike every other witnessed theft in the game), yet asking her about it afterward gets a reaction ('fresh scratches round the keyhole... Someone tried this before ever asking') as if she does know -- mixed signal on whether the theft was actually witnessed.
